tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background: a very light sea-salt, just warm enough to read as paper. Cards sit on it in white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, inputs: anything that sits on canvas.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, ghost buttons and nav items on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: segmented-control track, progress track, icon tiles, disabled fills, inner panels.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger dividers and outline badges.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Resting border of inputs, selects and secondary buttons. Deliberately soft (≈1.5:1): fields are also identified by their label, white fill and shadow-xs; hover darkens to control-border-hover, focus adds focus-ring + focus-halo.

tokens.name: control-border-hover
tokens.usage: Border of a hovered input or select; resting border of checkboxes.

tokens.name: switch-off
tokens.usage: Track of a Switch that is off (the white knob carries a shadow).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Graphite near-black: primary text and headings on canvas, surface, surface-sunken and every *-soft tint (≥12:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and currency symbols on canvas, surface and surface-sunken (≥6.9:1).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Metadata, dates, placeholders and section labels on canvas, surface and surface-sunken (≥5:1).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only — exempt from contrast, never for readable content.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Graphite: primary buttons, selected states, checked controls, links; as text on surface or primary-soft (≥12:1).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (13.6:1).

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Warm neutral tint behind primary text: active item on a light Sidebar, info alert, avatar, transfer tile.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The brand accent, used sparingly: accent button, floating add button, brand mark, active nav icon on inverse, active tab pip, chart series 2. Never body text; never a large background.

tokens.name: gold-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of gold buttons.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Pale gold tint for highlights and selected chips; text on it is ink or gold-ink.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold as text, when a word must carry the accent: on surface and gold-soft (≥4.7:1).

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gold fill (8.7:1).

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Dark graphite surface: the inverse Sidebar (drawn as a gradient inverse-top → inverse → inverse-bottom with a faint gold glow), banners.

tokens.name: inverse-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the inverse Sidebar gradient (darkest).

tokens.name: inverse-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the inverse Sidebar gradient.

tokens.name: inverse-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of items on inverse — translucent so it follows the gradient.

tokens.name: inverse-active
tokens.usage: Selected item fill on inverse.

tokens.name: inverse-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers on inverse.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on inverse (≥10:1).

tokens.name: on-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Idle nav items and secondary text on inverse (≥7.8:1).

tokens.name: on-inverse-subtle
tokens.usage: Section labels and counts on inverse (≥6:1).

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Warm decorative accent — illustrations, empty-state art, chart backgrounds. Never text.

tokens.name: income
tokens.usage: Money in: income amounts, positive deltas, success. A clear green; text on surface, canvas and income-soft (≥4.6:1). Always paired with a + sign or an arrow, so it never relies on hue alone.

tokens.name: income-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind income text: income tiles, positive delta chip, success alert.

tokens.name: expense
tokens.usage: Money out: expense amounts, negative deltas, over-budget, destructive actions. A clear red; text on surface, canvas and expense-soft (≥4.7:1). Always paired with a − sign or an arrow.

tokens.name: expense-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind expense text: expense tiles, negative delta chip, danger alert.

tokens.name: invest
tokens.usage: Investments: portfolio amounts, investment tiles and badges; text on surface and invest-soft (≥5.9:1).

tokens.name: invest-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind invest text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Attention: budgets near the limit, pending items; text on surface and warning-soft (≥5.2:1). Brown-amber, kept distinct from the gold accent.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning text: pending badge, warning alert.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Alias of income for generic success states.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Alias of expense for generic error/destructive states.

tokens.name: cat-1
tokens.usage: Category colour 1 (ochre) — icon in a category tile and category dots; suggested for: Food & dining by default. ≥4.7:1 on cat-1-soft. Never for amounts.

tokens.name: cat-1-soft
tokens.usage: Tile background behind cat-1.

tokens.name: cat-2
tokens.usage: Category colour 2 (teal) — icon in a category tile and category dots; suggested for: Income sources: salary, freelance. ≥4.7:1 on cat-2-soft. Never for amounts.

tokens.name: cat-2-soft
tokens.usage: Tile background behind cat-2.

tokens.name: cat-3
tokens.usage: Category colour 3 (caramel) — icon in a category tile and category dots; suggested for: Shopping. ≥4.7:1 on cat-3-soft. Never for amounts.

tokens.name: cat-3-soft
tokens.usage: Tile background behind cat-3.

tokens.name: cat-4
tokens.usage: Category colour 4 (plum) — icon in a category tile and category dots; suggested for: Investments. ≥4.7:1 on cat-4-soft. Never for amounts.

tokens.name: cat-4-soft
tokens.usage: Tile background behind cat-4.

tokens.name: cat-5
tokens.usage: Category colour 5 (slate) — icon in a category tile and category dots; suggested for: Transport. ≥4.7:1 on cat-5-soft. Never for amounts.

tokens.name: cat-5-soft
tokens.usage: Tile background behind cat-5.

tokens.name: cat-6
tokens.usage: Category colour 6 (sage) — icon in a category tile and category dots; suggested for: Housing and home. ≥4.7:1 on cat-6-soft. Never for amounts.

tokens.name: cat-6-soft
tokens.usage: Tile background behind cat-6.

tokens.name: cat-7
tokens.usage: Category colour 7 (rose) — icon in a category tile and category dots; suggested for: Health and personal care. ≥4.7:1 on cat-7-soft. Never for amounts.

tokens.name: cat-7-soft
tokens.usage: Tile background behind cat-7.

tokens.name: cat-8
tokens.usage: Category colour 8 (graphite) — icon in a category tile and category dots; suggested for: Transfers, fees and uncategorised. ≥4.7:1 on cat-8-soft. Never for amounts.

tokens.name: cat-8-soft
tokens.usage: Tile background behind cat-8.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px graphite outline with 2px offset on buttons and nav; 1px border plus focus-halo on fields (≥12:1).

tokens.name: focus-halo
tokens.usage: Soft 3px gold halo around a focused field, paired with a focus-ring border.

tokens.name: danger-halo
tokens.usage: Soft 3px halo around a focused input that has an error.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modal dialogs.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 — graphite, the largest or primary series.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 — gold.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 — mid grey.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 — teal.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 — stone.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6 — mauve. Beyond six series, group the rest as “Other” in line-strong.

families.sans: "Geist Variable", Geist, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "Geist Mono Variable", "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: text-amount-xl
styles.usage: Hero balances and StatCard values. Always tabular figures (.bs-num).

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: One page title per screen on desktop.

styles.name: text-amount-lg
styles.usage: Secondary totals: card totals, dialog amounts.

styles.name: text-title-lg
styles.usage: Page titles on mobile, section titles on desktop.

styles.name: text-title
styles.usage: Dialog titles and large card titles.

styles.name: text-body-strong
styles.usage: Row titles, labels inside lists, emphasised body.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Form labels, button text (sm), stat labels.

styles.name: text-overline
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels in navigation; use sparingly.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row gaps, input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between related elements; button padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; list row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a page.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page padding on desktop; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large section breaks.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top-level page rhythm on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, small swatches, segment buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, nav items, icon tiles, alerts, amount input.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, stat cards, tables.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, switches, progress tracks, pill search, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, secondary buttons — a hint of lift that separates a field from the card.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards and the selected segment — barely there; the line border does the work.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the floating add button.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs only.

size.note: Control heights. Every interactive control uses one of these three.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, inline filters, compact icon buttons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height for buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary mobile actions and touch-first forms.

layout.note: Layout constants for app shells built with Aurum.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop navigation rail.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the main content column.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: Below this: BottomNav replaces Sidebar, cards stack one per row.
